description: Takes over Rack's cable opacity and tension, room brightness, light bloom and spotlight settings and puts them under knob and CV control

params.text: Hands the Rack view settings to this module while lit, and releases them when unlit
Sets the brightness of Rack's spotlight
Sets the radius of Rack's spotlight

inputs.text: A trigger above 0V switches the module between holding the Rack settings and releasing them
A trigger above 0V toggles Rack's dark panels setting
Modulates the brightness of Rack's spotlight
Modulates the radius of Rack's spotlight

notes: one instance holds the Rack settings, and any further instance is marked as zombified on the light bulb
Rack's settings follow this module only while it is active; when the module is added its knobs take up Rack's current settings
menu: Override Rack sets which values win when the module is activated: its own knob positions, or the current Rack settings
Deactivation Defaults restores Rack's own default settings when the module is deactivated or bypassed
Module Browser Deactivation releases the Rack settings for as long as the module browser is open
Keyboard Shortcuts remaps the keys that lock module positions and toggle smart rearrangement, Shift-L and Shift-S by default
Set Defaults stores the current knob positions, the active state and the menu settings as the ones a new instance starts from
CV Param Mode sets how every CV input acts on its knob: Offset adds the CV to it, Follow sets it from the CV, Attenuate scales the CV by it
CV Input Slew smooths every CV input, which stops abrupt CV changes jumping the setting: None, 1ms, 5ms, 10ms, 25ms, 50ms or 100ms

inputs.5: high above 0V · stepped · one channel only
